qualification: Authored20ms WAV/AIFF and matching VP9/PCM control reproduce seven silent ambiguities. Four split/repeated data/SSND cases return only80of160frames and10ms; contradictory fmt/fact/COMM declarations silently choose the first. After direct duplicate correction, a top-level data prefix plus LIST/wavl still loses80frames, separately reproduced.

Unsupported multiple data/SSND or LIST/wavl audio payloads now refuse explicitly; contradictory layout/count metadata gives precise conflict errors. Raw metadata ranges avoid extra header copies. This is refusal of unsupported topology, not acceptance or concatenation of multipart audio.

Nine normal controls preserve exact native PCM and actual worker playback/rewind/EOF: single payload, byte-identical metadata, identical/empty unstated fact, reordered layout/data, unknown chunks and INFO containing wavl text. Nine unsupported/conflicting cases refuse for their specific topology/header error.

The actual Player factory refuses split WAV/AIFF and nested wavl prefixes without an audio handle, while normal/INFO controls retain20ms duration.33 WAV/14 AIFF/31 worker tests, related input-limit/EOF/precision integrations, deterministic fixtures and player build pass.

The primary RIFF description supports chunk roles and word-padding handling; no claim that all multipart layouts are forbidden by the standard is made. Native multipart/list audio decoding remains unimplemented. No private media, FFmpeg/network, physical DAC, public signature or performance claim.
compatibility: Previously accepted ambiguous or unsupported audio topologies now fail instead of playing an arbitrary prefix. Producers must consolidate into one supported data/SSND run and consistent layout/count declarations. Identical metadata and ordinary metadata/order tolerance are retained.
counting: One silent audio-chunk topology arbitration problem in analogous WAV/AIFF readers. Payload/header/list variants and migration controls add no IDs.
